description:
Discontinued, superseded by the Soul Gen5. This page is kept as an archive record for owners and for anyone researching an older Cotic Soul.

Years of production: 2014-2017

The Cotic Soul Gen4: the ultimate expression of a modern steel hardtail, now on 27.5" wheels. The Soul is the founding model of the Cotic range, conceived in 2003 to balance light weight with toughness and great handling. By Gen4 it had grown dropper seatpost compatibility, a tapered head tube, 27.5" wheels and finally a bolt-thru axle option, while keeping the full Reynolds 853 front triangle.

Tough, light, zippy, fun, interactive, durable, comfortable. We bombed down Pyrenean mountains on our Souls, battered across the rocks of the Peak District, Lakes and Scotland, and strapped bags on for nights out in the hills. It was great at all of that, but at heart the Soul was a singletrack scalpel: fast, responsive, sharp and, most of all, fun.

27.5" wheels bring easier acceleration, lighter weight and a more interactive feel than 29" or Plus wheels, at the expense of slightly less stability and rollover on rougher terrain. They also package more easily into a small frame, which suits shorter riders, helped further by the XS size added for 2017.

Finishes (2017): Gloss Aqua and Matte Bright Orange. Earlier Gen4 frames were also shown in orange and blue.
Sizes: XS (14.5", new for 2017), Small (16"), Medium (17.5") and Large (19").

frame.front_derailleur_mount: Shimano Side Swing, top clamp 34.9mm, front entry (2017), routed in P-clips along the down tube

components.description: 44mm external cup lower, 34mm traditional standard upper (EC34/EC44)
regular 135 x 10mm QR, or Boost 148 x 12mm thru axle (2017 option). Frames are dedicated to one axle type
